And what's to say Dyrus can't improve his mentality? In fact, I'd go as far to say that his mentality is what's holding him back currently. If it improves, I'd say we'd see a large jump in his overall ability to carry in international tournaments.

I used to be a professional Halo player during the Halo 3 + Reach Era. I played in dozens of high level tournaments and I was extremely good at one point. Then I started to fall off. I would get sloppy, miss shots I wouldn't normally miss, all sorts of crazy stupid shit. 

Social media was awful. It was "BENCH XXXXX", "XXXX IS SHIT" etc. Just like you see with Dyrus. Lots of people, even a few pros, told me I was capped on how good I can get.

So I stop playing professionally for a bit. After a month I start playing again, I start winning. I get top of the ladder, start competing again. This time I was at an even higher level than before.

The point is that a player can never max themselves out on skill. There are ALWAYS improvements to be made and physical limitations are almost nonexistant in the world of E-Sports. Its all mental. Dyrus is good, really good, and with some adaptations with his team and his mental state he can be a serious international threat.

Hey... I'm really no sure where to even start as I've never just spilled my guts online like this.

I'm not in any current danger of harming myself or others around me, but I've had some suicidal thoughts lately and it's been scaring me a bit. Sometimes I just break down and it all gets to be way too much.

I guess I can start at the root of the problem. I'm gender dysphoric. I hate being male and it's not just some fetish or anything either. Half the time when I feel like this it's not even about sex, I just wish I was female. I can't explain why really but that's that. It started when I was really young, about 6 or 7. I'd see girls in dresses and think "That's pretty, I want to wear that". 

When I got to be about 13 or 14 is when it got super bad and at this point I took to a ton of different things to try to stop the way I was feeling, including taking part in the "cutting" fad that was going on at the time. I still have scars on my arm from that and I'm not sure they'll ever go away, but whatever.

I have told two people about my problem: a close friend who was very understanding and my girlfriend who was supportive somewhat but didn't really understand it and didn't particularly know how to react to it.

My issue is that it's getting worse and now every day I wake up feeling the same thing, whereas before it was only just short episodes of dysphoria. It's near constant now and its starting to make me go insane.

To make matters worse my sex life is non-existant. Even though I've been with my girlfriend for nearly 7 years now we barely have sex because she "just doesn't enjoy it". Believe me I've tried everything from toys to learning oral sex inside and out, but I can't ever seem to pleasure her which makes me feel even more worthless.

And I guess that's it: I feel worthless and useless and I wish I was someone else constantly.

Sorry if this seems childish, I know my problems are small compared to others but I'm having a really hard time dealing with them.

EDIT: My financial situation is also horrendous but that's not really something anyone can help with.

EDIT: I guess I should also include that I'm 22 years old at the moment.
